strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Logiciel ya koteka na motuka (van sales)
strings.tierB.home.description: Mpo na ba distributeurs: fakitire mpe resi na telefone, stock ya motuka, kozwa mbongo, nzela mpe botali basombi. Esalaka ata internet ezali te.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Kamba bateki na yo ya nzela banda botali ya liboso tii mbongo ya suka oyo ezwami
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales ezali etando ya cloud mpo na ba entreprises ya distribution mpe ba grossistes oyo bazali na bateki ya nzela (commerciaux terrain, van sales). Bateki basalaka mpe babimisaka na imprimante ba fakitire mpe ba resi na telefone na bango, balandaka stock oyo ezali na motuka mpe bakomaka botali, nzokande bakambi bamonaka mbala moko biloko oyo etekami, mbongo oyo ezwami mpe banyongo ya basombi.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Fakitire na telefone ya moteki
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Moteki asalaka fakitire na ekuke ya mosombi mpe abimisaka yango na imprimante thermique ya Bluetooth liboso ya kobima na butiki.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Kozwa mbongo mpe banyongo ya basombi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Lifuti moko na moko ezwaka resi na nimero, ekangisami na ba fakitire oyo efuti, mpe nyongo ya mosombi na relevé ya compte na ye ebongwanaka mbala moko.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Stock oyo moteki azali na yango na motuka
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Stock ya motuka moko na moko elandamaka eloko na eloko: oyo etiamaki, oyo etekamaki, oyo ezongisamaki mpe oyo etikali, boye ete bokeseni emonanaka mokolo yango kaka.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Nzela mpe botali basombi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Botali nyonso ekomamaka na esika, ngonga mpe bafoto, mpe nzela ya moteki moko na moko emonisamaka na karte mpo na mokambi.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Esalaka kozanga internet
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Bateki bakobaka koteka ata reseau ezali te. Mikanda etikalaka na telefone mpe etindamaka yango moko, kozanga kozongela, tango internet ezongi.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Tableau de bord ya web mpo na bakambi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Biloko etekami, mbongo ezwami, oyo ezongisami, stock mpe mosala ya bateki na esika moko, na mikumba mpe ndingisa mpo na mosaleli moko na moko.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Yebisa biso ndenge bozali koteka
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Senga devis to bongisa likita. Tokotala bateki na bino, banzela, biloko mpe bamposa na bino mpo na ba fakitire.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Bongisa entreprise na yo
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Tia biloko, ntalo na yango, basombi mpe bateki, mpe na ba paramètres tia mbongo mpe mpako ya mboka na yo.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Tinda bateki na nzela
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Bateki batiaka application na Android to iPhone, batondisaka motuka mpe babandaka koteka, kobimisa fakitire na imprimante mpe kozwa mbongo.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Landa mokolo ndenge ezali kokende
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Tableau de bord ya web emonisaka biloko etekami, mbongo ezwami, stock ya motuka mpe botali, wana bateki bazali naino na nzela.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales ezali etando ya cloud mpo na kokamba bateki ya nzela na ba entreprises ya distribution mpe ya ba grossistes. Ezali na van sales (koteka na motuka), route sales (koteka na banzela oyo eyebani), pre-sales (kozwa ba commandes liboso) mpe DSD (komema biloko mbala moko na butiki). Bateki basalaka fakitire, babimisaka yango na imprimante, bazwaka mbongo mpe bakomaka botali na telefone, mpe bakambi balandaka biloko etekami, mbongo ezwami, stock ya motuka mpe banyongo ya basombi na tableau de bord ya web.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Iyo. Application ya moteki ekobaka kosala kozanga internet: moteki asalaka mpe abimisaka ba fakitire mpe ba resi, akomaka botali mpe abakisaka basombi ya sika, mpe nyonso etindamaka yango moko kozanga kozongela tango internet ezongi. Ezali na bokeseni moko na Arabie Saoudite: ba entreprises oyo bafungoli bokangisi na e-invoicing basengeli kozala na internet na ngonga oyo bazali kobimisa fakitire to fakitire ya biloko ezongisami.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales esalelaka ba entreprises ya distribution na mikili nyonso. Entreprise moko na moko etiaka mbongo na yango mpe mpako na ba paramètres na yango, mpe ba fakitire, ba resi mpe ba rapports esalelaka yango. FieldSales ezali na biro monene na Riyadh, Arabie Saoudite, mpe kobanda esalemaka na internet na nzela ya mayangani, WhatsApp mpe lisalisi ya mosika.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales ekangisamaka na ba systèmes ya Leta ya e-invoicing?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Tosungaka bokangisi ya etape ya mibale na etando Fatoora ya ZATCA. Yango etali ba entreprises oyo ezali na Arabie Saoudite. Na mikili mosusu, ata na RDC mpe na Congo-Brazzaville, FieldSales esalaka ba fakitire na mbongo na yo mpe mpako na yo, mpe bokangisi na système ya mboka ya e-invoicing ekoki kozwama soki osengi, nsima ya kotalela elongo na yo makambo oyo mboka yango esengaka. Libanda ya Arabie Saoudite tolakaka te ete ba fakitire ekoyokana na makambo oyo mboka moko esengaka.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: Application ya FieldSales ezali na minoko nini?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Interface ya application FieldSales ezali kaka na minoko oyo: Liarabe, Lingelesa, Lifalanse, Liturki mpe Lisinwa. Ezali te na Lingala. Bateki mpe bakambi bakoki kobongola monoko ya interface, mpe ba fakitire oyo ebimisami na imprimante ekoki kozala na monoko ya mibale pembeni ya monoko ya liboso. Ba pages ya site na minoko mosusu, ata page oyo ya Lingala, ezali bobongoli mpo na koyebisa makambo ya FieldSales kaka.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Senga devis, bongisa likita to tindela biso message na WhatsApp. Toyekolaka ndenge bateki na yo basalaka, sima tosalisaka yo kotia biloko, ntalo na yango, basombi mpe bateki. Bateki batiaka application na Android to iPhone, mpe bakambi basalelaka tableau de bord na navigateur nyonso. Ba smartphones nde biloko kaka oyo osengeli na yango.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Interface ya application FieldSales ezali na minoko oyo: Liarabe, Lingelesa, Lifalanse, Liturki mpe Lisinwa. Ezali te na Lingala. Ba pages na minoko mosusu elimbolaka FieldSales mpo na koyebisa kaka.
strings.tierB.category.title: Logiciel ya van sales (koteka na motuka) | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Logiciel ya van sales mpe route sales: fakitire na telefone mpe imprimante, stock ya motuka, kozwa mbongo mpe botali. Esalaka kozanga internet.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Logiciel ya van sales (koteka na motuka) mpo na ba distributeurs mpe ba grossistes
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales ezali logiciel ya van sales mpo na ba entreprises oyo bateki na bango batekaka na motuka na banzela mikolo nyonso. Moteki atondisaka motuka, atekaka na butiki moko na moko, abimisaka fakitire na imprimante, azwaka mbongo mpe akomaka biloko ezongisami na application moko na telefone. Mokambi amonaka oyo etiamaki, oyo etekamaki, mbongo ezwami mpe oyo etikali na motuka moko na moko.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Logiciel ya van sales ezali nini?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Logiciel ya van sales, oyo babengaka mpe cash van to route sales, ekambaka lolenge ya koteka epai moteki amemaka biloko na motuka mpe atekaka, apesaka biloko, asalaka fakitire mpe azwaka mbongo na botali moko. Ezwaka esika ya babuku ya fakitire ya papie mpe ya ba appels ya pokwa. Ekomaka koteka nyonso, lifuti nyonso mpe eloko nyonso oyo ezongisami lokola mokanda, boye stock mpe mbongo ekoki kotalelama mokolo yango kaka. Mpo na mokambi, ezongisaka mituna misato pokwa nyonso: moteki moko na moko atekaki nini, azwaki mbongo boni, mpe nini etikali naino na motuka moko na moko.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Mokolo moko na nzela
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Mokolo ebandaka na kotondisa motuka uta na depo, na mokanda. Na butiki moko na moko, moteki aponaka mosombi na application, abakisaka biloko na liste to na barcode, asalaka fakitire mpe abimisaka yango na imprimante thermique. Lifuti ekomamaka na resi, mpe eloko nyonso oyo ezongisami ekomamaka na ntina na yango. Na pokwa, oyo etikali na motuka ezongisamaka na depo. Na kati ya ba etapes wana, mokambi akoki kolanda biloko etekami, mbongo ezwami mpe botali ya moteki moko na moko na tableau de bord ya web, kozanga kobenga moto moko.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Esalemi mpo na bisika oyo reseau ezali makasi te
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Banzela ya distribution elekaka na ba sous-sols, na bisika ya ba usines mpe na bamboka oyo reseau ezali makasi te. Application ya moteki ya FieldSales ebombaka basombi, biloko mpe ntalo na yango na telefone, boye moteki akoki kosala mpe kobimisa mikanda kozanga internet. Mokanda moko na moko ezali na nimero na yango moko ya kokesena, boye ekomaka na serveur mbala moko kaka, ata soki botindi ezongelami mbala mingi. Ba entreprises ya Arabie Saoudite oyo bafungoli bokangisi na e-invoicing basengeli kozala na internet na ngonga oyo babimisaka ba fakitire mpe ba fakitire ya biloko ezongisami. Ba resi, botali mpe basombi ya sika ekobaka kosala kozanga internet mpo na bango.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Kozwa mbongo mpe stock ya motuka
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Mbongo oyo ememamaka na nzela esengeli kotalelama lokola stock. Mbongo nyonso oyo ezwami ezwaka resi na nimero oyo ekoki kokangisama na ba fakitire oyo efuti, mpe nyongo ya mosombi ebongwanaka mbala moko. Stock ya motuka etangamaka eloko na eloko: oyo etiamaki longola oyo etekamaki, bakisa oyo ezongisamaki mpe bobongisi nyonso oyo ekomami, boye bakambi bakoki kokokanisa yango na botangi ya solo liboso moteki azonga na ndako. Biloko ezongisami ekoki kokabolama: ya momesano, oyo ebebi to ya kobongola, mpe mokambi nde azwaka mokano soki ezongi na stock ya motuka oyo ekoki kotekama.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Mpo na nani?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales ebongi mpo na ba distributeurs mpe ba grossistes ya biloko oyo etekamaka noki lokola bilei, masanga, biloko ya bopetoli mpe ya kobatela nzoto, mpe entreprise nyonso oyo ezali na bateki oyo batalaka ba butiki na banzela. Esungaka van sales, ba commandes ya pre-sales mpe DSD (komema biloko mbala moko na butiki). Ezali ERP ya mobimba te: ekangisamaka na système na yo ya comptabilité to ERP na nzela ya API. Bakambi nde bakataka oyo moteki moko na moko akoki kosala, lokola kopesa remise, koteka na se ya ntalo ya liste to kobakisa basombi ya sika.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Bokeseni nini ezali kati ya van sales mpe pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Na van sales, moteki amemaka biloko, apesaka yango, asalaka fakitire mpe azwaka mbongo na botali moko. Na pre-sales, moteki azwaka commande, mpe depo ememaka yango sima. FieldSales esungaka balolenge mibale nyonso, boye entreprise ekoki kosalela cash van na banzela mosusu mpe kozwa ba commandes na mosusu. Na balolenge mibale nyonso, ba fakitire, mbongo ezwami mpe banyongo ya basombi ezali na système moko, mpe bakambi bamonaka yango na ba rapports moko.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Ndenge nini nakokanisa stock ya motuka na pokwa?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales emonisaka, mpo na eloko moko na moko na motuka moko na moko, motango oyo etiamaki, oyo etekamaki, oyo ezongisamaki mpe oyo etikali. Kokanisa motango oyo etikali na botangi ya solo, koma bokeseni lokola bobongisi oyo ekomami, sima zongisa oyo etikali na depo na mosala moko. Motuka ebandaka mokolo oyo elandi na compte ya peto oyo eyebani.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Moteki ya van sales asengeli na biloko nini?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Smartphone, Android to iPhone. Imprimante thermique ya Bluetooth ezali ya kopona, kasi esalisaka moteki apesa mosombi fakitire to resi oyo ebimisami na imprimante. FieldSales etekaka bisaleli te mpe esengaka marque moko ya imprimante te. Bakambi basalelaka tableau de bord na navigateur ya ordinateur to ya telefone nyonso.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales ekoki kokangisama na système na biso ya comptabilité?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Iyo. FieldSales epesaka API oyo epesaka nzela na système na yo ya comptabilité to ERP kopesana na etando basombi, biloko, ba fakitire, ba resi mpe bokei ya stock. Équipe na yo to intégrateur na yo asalaka bokangisi yango na lisalisi ya mikanda oyo elimbolaka API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales na mikili: mbongo, mpako mpe e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales esalelaka ba distributeurs na mikili nyonso. Tala mbongo, mpako mpe e-invoicing ya mboka moko na moko na tableau moko.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales esalelaka ba entreprises ya distribution na mikili nyonso. Entreprise moko na moko eponaka mboka na yango, mbongo mpe mpako na ba paramètres na yango, mpe ba fakitire, ba resi mpe ba rapports elandaka yango. Bokangisi na e-invoicing ya Leta ezali kosala kaka na Arabie Saoudite. Na mikili mosusu nyonso ekoki kozwama soki osengi. Tableau oyo ezali na se emonisaka, mpo na mboka moko na moko, mbongo oyo basalelaka, mpako ya momesano na koteka to TVA, mpe soki bokangisi na e-invoicing ya Leta ezali kosala to ekoki kozwama soki osengi.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Tosungaka bokangisi ya etape ya mibale na etando Fatoora ya ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Mbongo mpe mpako etiamaka na entreprise moko na moko na ba paramètres na yango moko. Mpako oyo ezali na tableau oyo ezali kaka litambwisi ya momesano mpe ekoki kobongwana; tala mibeko ya lelo elongo na conseiller na yo ya mpako. Molongo (—) elakisi ete mpako ya momesano ekomami te mpo na mboka yango.
strings.tierB.about.title: Na ntina na FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales esalaka logiciel ya cloud mpo na ba entreprises ya distribution oyo bazali na bateki ya nzela. Ebandaki na 2026 na Riyadh, Arabie Saoudite.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (kombo na Liarabe: فيلد سيلز) ezali etando ya cloud mpo na ba entreprises ya distribution mpe ba grossistes oyo bazali na bateki ya nzela. Entreprise ebandaki na 2026 mpe ezali na biro monene na Riyadh, Arabie Saoudite. Esalelaka ba entreprises na mikili nyonso, mpe mbongo mpe mpako ya mboka moko na moko etiamaka na ba paramètres ya entreprise yango moko. Basombi na biso bazali ba entreprises oyo batekaka mpe bamemaka biloko na nzela ya bateki oyo bazali na nzela: ba distributeurs, ba grossistes mpe ba usines oyo bazali na mituka na bango ya koteka.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Tosalaka système moko oyo ekangani mpo na mosala mobimba ya nzela: ba fakitire oyo ebimisamaka na imprimante uta na telefone ya moteki, ba resi mpe banyongo ya basombi, stock oyo moteki azali na yango na motuka, banzela mpe botali na esika mpe bafoto, mpe tableau de bord ya web mpo na bakambi. Application ya moteki esalaka na Android mpe iPhone mpe ekobaka kosala kozanga internet, sima etindaka mikanda tango internet ezongi. Ba entreprises bakoki kokangisa FieldSales na système na bango ya comptabilité to ERP na nzela ya API, boye makambo ya nzela esengeli te kokomama mbala mibale.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Tolimbolaka logiciel ndenge ezali. Tosungaka bokangisi ya etape ya mibale na etando Fatoora ya ZATCA. Bokangisi na ba systèmes ya Leta na mikili mosusu ekoki kozwama soki osengi. Interface ya application ezali na minoko oyo: Liarabe, Lingelesa, Lifalanse, Liturki mpe Lisinwa. Ezali te na Lingala. Mpo na kosolola na biso, senga devis, bongisa likita to tindela biso message na WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Solola na FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Solola na équipe ya FieldSales: senga devis, bongisa likita to solola na biso na WhatsApp mpo na logiciel ya van sales mpe ya bateki ya nzela.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Yebisa biso ndenge bateki na yo batekaka lelo mpe nini olingi kobongola. Senga devis, bongisa likita to tindela biso message na WhatsApp, mpe moto moko ya équipe na biso akozongisela yo. Mpo na lisalisi, basombi na biso oyo bazali kosalela biso bakoki kosalela banzela wana moko. Esalisaka soki oyebisi mboka na yo, motango ya bateki, mpe soki batekaka na motuka, bazwaka ba commandes, to nyonso mibale.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Bongisa likita na internet elongo na équipe na biso. Tokolakisa yo mokolo ya moteki na application mpe tableau de bord ya mokambi, na bandakisa oyo ekokani na biloko na yo mpe banzela na yo, mpe tokozongisa mituna na yo na ntina na kobanda.
